title: Agent Court
exportLabel: Edited demo from actual production runtime captures
captureRequirement: Unmodified screenshots from the running production build. Cuts and captions explain the captured flow; this export is not a continuous screen recording.
financialMode: Simulated refunds only; no real money moves.

scenes.heading: WHO CHALLENGES THE AGENT?
scenes.caption: Before an autonomous agent acts, it may have to defend the action.

scenes.heading: LOW RISK. CLEARED TO PROCEED.
scenes.caption: A permitted €80 refund executes automatically. All refunds are simulated.

scenes.heading: €850 REQUESTED. THE COURT OPENS.
scenes.caption:
Executor proposes. Evidence verifies a €425 limit. Risk objects.
Four real CometChat identities; the action waits for a human decision.

scenes.heading: THE HUMAN CHANGES THE ACTION.
scenes.caption:
APPROVE €425 is a real CometChat message.
The server reads it back and validates its sender, room and policy.

scenes.heading: €425 EXECUTED. €425 PREVENTED.
scenes.caption:
A receipt records the human decision and simulated execution.
€425 of policy-violating refund prevented in this simulated case.

scenes.heading: BUILT WITH COMETCHAT SKILLS.
scenes.caption:
Official CometChat Skills installed and used in the build.
Real group chat carries the decision; no synthetic transcript.

scenes.heading: GIVE AGENTS SOMEWHERE TO ANSWER.
scenes.caption: Agent Court · Zero to Chat · Real chat. Deterministic policy. Simulated money.
